```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split at a vertical separator column.
    sep = next((j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))), None)
    if sep is not None and sep > 0 and w - sep - 1 == sep:
        left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        base = max(set(v for row in right for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in right))
        return [[3 if left[i][j] == right[i][j] else base for j in range(sep)] for i in range(h)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find a solid separator, vertical or horizontal.
    v = next((j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))), None)
    if v is not None and v > 0 and w - v - 1 == v:
        a = [row[:v] for row in grid]
        b = [row[v + 1:] for row in grid]
        colors_a = set(x for row in a for x in row)
        colors_b = set(x for row in b for x in row)
        common = colors_a & colors_b
        if len(common) == 1 and 0 in colors_a:
            c = next(iter(common))
            return [[c] * v for _ in range(h)]
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == b[i][j] else 2 for j in range(v)] for i in range(h)]

    # Horizontal separator: retain the top panel, encoding its non-background
    # color as 3 and its background as 4.
    s = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if s is not None and s > 0 and h - s - 1 == s:
        top = grid[:s]
        bg = max(set(x for row in top for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in top))
        return [[4 if x == bg else 3 for x in row] for row in top]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate a uniform divider and split the grid into matching-sized panels.
    for j in range(w):
        if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h)):
            if j > 0 and w - j - 1 == j:
                left = [row[:j] for row in grid]
                right = [row[j + 1:] for row in grid]
                a = set(x for row in left for x in row)
                b = set(x for row in right for x in row)
                shared = a & b
                if len(shared) == 1:
                    color = next(iter(shared))
                    # A panel dominated by a distinct background yields the
                    # shared color throughout; otherwise mark matching cells.
                    bg = max(a, key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in left))
                    if bg not in shared:
                        return [[color] * j for _ in range(h)]
                    return [[3 if left[i][k] == right[i][k] else color
                             for k in range(j)] for i in range(h)]
            break

    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and i > 0 and h - i - 1 == i:
            top = grid[:i]
            bottom = grid[i + 1:]
            a = set(x for r in top for x in r)
            b = set(x for r in bottom for x in r)
            shared = a & b
            color = next(iter(shared)) if len(shared) == 1 else 0
            return [[3 if top[r][c] == bottom[r][c] else color
                     for c in range(w)] for r in range(i)]

    return [row[:] for row in grid]
```
